notes: Keys are sanitize(name) = name.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_-]/g, ''); nodesRaw carries the original Z-Anatomy names, index-aligned with nodes.

Boundary structures assigned by convention: Central sulcus to frontal, Parieto-occipital sulcus to occipital, parahippocampal and fusiform gyri to temporal, paracentral gyrus and sulcus to frontal, Lat_Fis-ant rami to frontal, Lat_Fis-post to temporal.
Cingulate gyrus segments, septal nuclei and the optic chiasm and tract sit in 'other' (no dedicated region id was specified); see other.subregions.
Falx cerebri and tentorium cerebelli are meninges, not brain tissue: listed under excluded.meninges.
Vestibule, Cochlear nerve and Vestibular nerve are dropped as inner-ear (Dundee CC BY-NC-SA) or inner-ear-adjacent parts. Vestibular nuclei and cochlear nuclei (brainstem) are kept.
White matter of telencephalon (L and R) dropped: no upstream licence stated and not needed for the exploded view.
